systems.country_label: Safe City Project (also Safe Country Project)
systems.platform: Huawei Technologies: CCTV smart camera surveillance system, multimedia radio trunking system, central watch and management system, integrated emergency response management system and intelligent command system
systems.owner: Mauritius Telecom Ltd as borrower under a government guarantee, for the police; China Eximbank buyer's credit of US$73,687,000 signed 1 April 2018
systems.tiers: 4,000 cameras in major public areas, 500 trunking handsets, 500 vehicle radios, 4,500 smartphones and 150 fixed desktop terminals; police stations at Cote d'Or, St Pierre, La Gaulette, Poudre d'Or and Petit Gabriel in Rodrigues named as expected beneficiaries

note: A loan record for a camera, radio and command system; the held text is an excerpt cut off mid-sentence, and it says nothing about how stations record a report or a case.
